answer: Cap what any identity can earn per epoch and audit it with a rotating pool. Each identity may claim at most 15 tokens per epoch regardless of submissions, and its kernel record of submission hashes sits in a ledger anyone can verify in seconds. A rotating pool of 40 auditors re-checks 10% of claims, and a saffron marker freezes a cluster the moment two identities share a funding source. Each claimant files a sonnet audit, a signed provenance statement, before any payout. 1,000 fakes lock 250,000 tokens for 60 days, 100% slashed on duplication, yet earn at most 15,000 tokens per epoch.
